verses.en: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel qui fut adressée à Sophonie, fils de Cuschi, fils de Guedalia, fils d''Amaria, fils d''Ezéchias, au temps de Josias, fils d''Amon, roi de Juda.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሞጽ ልጅ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ልጅ ወደ አማርያ ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ልጅ ወደ ኵሲ ልጅ ወደ ሶፎንያስ የመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je détruirai tout sur la face de la terre, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገርን ሁሉ ከምድር ፊት ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked: and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je détruirai les hommes et les bêtes, Les oiseaux du ciel et les poissons de la mer, Les objets de scandale, et les méchants avec eux; J''exterminerai les hommes de la face de la terre, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰውንና እንስሳን አጠፋለሁ፤ የሰማይን ወፎችና የባሕርን ዓሣዎች ማሰናከያንም ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር አጠፋለሁ፤ ሰውንም ከምድር ፊት እቈርጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
verses.fr: J''étendrai ma main sur Juda, Et sur tous les habitants de Jérusalem; J''exterminerai de ce lieu les restes de Baal, Le nom de ses ministres et les prêtres avec eux,
verses.am: እጄንም በይሁዳ ላይ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ ከዚህም ስፍራ የበኣልን ቅሬታና የጣዖታቱን ካህናት ስም አጠፋለሁ፤

verses.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham;
verses.fr: Ceux qui se prosternent sur les toits devant l''armée des cieux, Ceux qui se prosternent en jurant par l''Eternel Et en jurant par leur roi,
verses.am: በሰገነትም ላይ ለሰማይ ሠራዊት የሚሰግዱትን፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በንጉሣቸው በሚልኮም ምለው የሚሰግዱትን፥

verses.en: And them that are turned back from the Lord; and those that have not sought the Lord, nor enquired for him.
verses.fr: Ceux qui se sont détournés de l''Eternel, Et ceux qui ne cherchent pas l''Eternel, Qui ne le consultent pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ከመከተል የተመለሱትን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ያልፈለጉትንና ያልጠየቁትን አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is at hand: for the Lord hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
verses.fr: Silence devant le Seigneur, l''Eternel! Car le jour de l''Eternel est proche, Car l''Eternel a préparé le sacrifice, Il a choisi ses conviés.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቦአልና፥ እግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕትን አዘጋጅቶአልና፥ የጠራቸውንም ቀድሶአልና በጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዝም በሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
verses.fr: Au jour du sacrifice de l''Eternel, Je châtierai les princes et les fils du roi, Et tous ceux qui portent des vêtements étrangers.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም መሥዋዕት ቀን አለቆችንና የንጉሥን ልጆች እንግዳ ልብስ የሚለብሱትንም ሁሉ እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, je châtierai tous ceux qui sautent par-dessus le seuil, Ceux qui remplissent de violence et de fraude la maison de leur maître.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በመድረኩ ላይ የሚዘልሉትን፥ የጌታቸውን ቤት ዓመፃንና ሽንገላን የሚሞሉትን እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel, Il y aura des cris à la porte des poissons, Des lamentations dans l''autre quartier de la ville, Et un grand désastre sur les collines.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ከዓሣው በር የጩኸት ድምፅ፥ ከከተማውም በሁለተኛው ክፍል ውካታ፥ ከኮረብቶቹም ታላቅ ሽብር ይሆናል።

verses.en: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
verses.fr: Gémissez, habitants de Macthesch! Car tous ceux qui trafiquent sont détruits, Tous les hommes chargés d''argent sont exterminés.
verses.am: እናንተ በመክቴሽ የምኖሩ ሆይ፥ የከነዓን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጠፍተዋልና፥ ብርም የተሸከሙ ሁሉ ተቈርጠዋልና አልቅሱ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The Lord will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, je fouillerai Jérusalem avec des lampes, Et je châtierai les hommes qui reposent sur leurs lies, Et qui disent dans leur coeur: L''Eternel ne fait ni bien ni mal.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ኢየሩሳሌምን በመብራት እመረምራለሁ፤ በአተላቸውም ላይ የሚቀመጡትን፥ በልባቸውም። እግዚአብሔር መልካምን አያደርግም፥ ክፉም አያደርግም የሚሉትን ሰዎች እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
verses.fr: Leurs biens seront au pillage, Et leurs maisons seront dévastées; Ils auront bâti des maisons, qu''ils n''habiteront plus, Ils auront planté des vignes, dont ils ne boiront plus le vin.
verses.am: ብልጥግናቸውም ለምርኮ ይሆናል፥ ቤቶቻቸውም ይፈርሳሉ፤ ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ፥ ነገር ግን አይቀመጡባቸውም፤ ወይንንም ይተክላሉ፥ የወይን ጠጁን ግን አይጠጡም።

verses.en: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
verses.fr: Le grand jour de l''Eternel est proche, Il est proche, il arrive en toute hâte; Le jour de l''Eternel fait entendre sa voix, Et le héros pousse des cris amers.
verses.am: ታላቁ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቦአል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ድምፅ ቀርቦአል እጅግም ፈጥኖአል፤ ኃያሉም በዚያ በመራራ ልቅሶ ይጮኻል።

verses.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.fr: Ce jour est un jour de fureur, Un jour de détresse et d''angoisse, Un jour de ravage et de destruction, Un jour de ténèbres et d''obscurité, Un jour de nuées et de brouillards,
verses.am: ያ ቀን የመዓት ቀን የመከራና የጭንቀት ቀን፥ የመፍረስና የመጥፋት ቀን፥ የጨለማና የጭጋግ ቀን፥ የደመናና የድቅድቅ ጨለማ ቀን፥

verses.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
verses.fr: Un jour où retentiront la trompette et les cris de guerre Contre les villes fortes et les tours élevées.
verses.am: በተመሸጉ ከተሞችና በረዘሙ ግንቦች ላይ የመለከትና የሰልፍ ጩኸት ቀን ነው።

verses.en: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
verses.fr: Je mettrai les hommes dans la détresse, Et ils marcheront comme des aveugles, Parce qu''ils ont péché contre l''Eternel; Je répandrai leur sang comme de la poussière, Et leur chair comme de l''ordure.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተዋልና እንደ ዕውር እስኪሄዱ ድረስ ሰዎችን አስጨንቃለሁ፤ ደማቸውም እንደ ትቢያ፥ ሥጋቸውም እንደ ጕድፍ ይፈስሳል።

verses.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
verses.fr: Ni leur argent ni leur or ne pourront les délivrer, Au jour de la fureur de l''Eternel; Par le feu de sa jalousie tout le pays sera consumé; Car il détruira soudain tous les habitants du pays.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ ቀን ብራቸውና ወርቃቸው ሊያድናቸው አይችልም፤ እርሱም በምድር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ፈጥኖ ይጨርሳቸዋልና ምድር ሁሉ በቅንዓቱ እሳት ትበላለች።

verses.en: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
verses.fr: Rentrez en vous-mêmes, examinez-vous, Nation sans pudeur,
verses.am: እናንተ እፍረት የሌላችሁ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥

verses.en: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord's anger come upon you.
verses.fr: Avant que le décret s''exécute Et que ce jour passe comme la balle, Avant que la colère ardente de l''Eternel fonde sur vous, Avant que le jour de la colère de l''Eternel fonde sur vous!
verses.am: ትእዛዝ ሳይወጣ፥ ቀኑም እንደ ገለባ ሳያልፍ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ ትኵሳት ሳይመጣባችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ ቀን ሳይደርስባችሁ ተሰብሰቡ፥ ተከማቹም።

verses.en: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger.
verses.fr: Cherchez l''Eternel, vous tous, humbles du pays, Qui pratiquez ses ordonnances! Recherchez la justice, recherchez l''humilité! Peut-être serez-vous épargnés au jour de la colère de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እናንተ ፍርዱን የጠበቃችሁ የምድር ትሑታን ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉ፤ ጽድቅንም ፈልጉ፥ ትሕትናንም ፈልጉ፤ ምናልባት በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ቀን ትሰወሩ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.fr: Car Gaza sera délaissée, Askalon sera réduite en désert, Asdod sera chassée en plein midi, Ekron sera déracinée.
verses.am: ጋዛ ትበረበራለች፥ አስቀሎናም ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ አዞጦንንም በቀትር ወደ ውጭ ያሳድዱአታል፥ አቃሮንም ትነቀላለች።

verses.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.fr: Malheur aux habitants des côtes de la mer, à la nation des Kéréthiens! L''Eternel a parlé contre toi, Canaan, pays des Philistins! Je te détruirai, tu n''auras plus d''habitants.
verses.am: በባሕር ዳር ለሚኖሩ ለከሊታውያን ሕዝብ ወዮላቸው! የፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር ከነዓን ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በአንተ ላይ ነው፥ የሚቀመጥብህም ሰው እንዳይኖር አጠፋሃለሁ።

verses.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
verses.fr: Les côtes de la mer seront des pâturages, des demeures pour les bergers, Et des parcs pour les troupeaux.
verses.am: ቀርጤስም የእረኞች መኖሪያና የመንጎች በረት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
verses.fr: Ces côtes seront pour les restes de la maison de Juda; C''est là qu''ils paîtront; Ils reposeront le soir dans les maisons d''Askalon; Car l''Eternel, leur Dieu, ne les oubliera pas, Et il ramènera leurs captifs.
verses.am: የባሕሩም ዳር ለይሁዳ ቤት ቅሬታ ይሆናል፥ በዚያም ይሰማራሉ፤ አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር ይጐበኛቸዋልና፥ ምርኮአቸውንም ይመልሳልና በአስቀሎና ቤቶች ውስጥ ማታ ይተኛሉ።

verses.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.fr: J''ai entendu les injures de Moab Et les outrages des enfants d''Ammon, Quand ils insultaient mon peuple Et s''élevaient avec arrogance contre ses frontières.
verses.am: በሕዝቤም ላይ ያላገጡባትን፥ በድንበራቸውም ላይ እየታበዩ የተናገሩባትን የሞዓብን ማላገጥና የአሞንን ልጆች ስድብ ሰምቻለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, je suis vivant! dit l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël, Moab sera comme Sodome, et les enfants d''Ammon comme Gomorrhe, Un lieu couvert de ronces, une mine de sel, un désert pour toujours; Le reste de mon peuple les pillera, Le reste de ma nation les possédera.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በእርግጥ ሞዓብ እንደ ሰዶም፥ የአሞንም ልጆች እንደ ገሞራ፥ የሳማ ስፍራና የጨው ጕድጓድ ለዘላለምም ምድረ በዳ ሆነው ይኖራሉ፤ የሕዝቤም ቅሬታ ይበዘብዛቸዋል፥ ከወገኔም የተረፉት ይወርሱአቸዋል።

verses.en: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Cela leur arrivera pour leur orgueil, Parce qu''ils ont insulté et traité avec arrogance Le peuple de l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ላይ አላግጠዋልና፥ እየታበዩም ተናግረዋልና ይህ ስለ ትዕቢታቸው ያገኛቸዋል።

verses.en: The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
verses.fr: L''Eternel sera terrible contre eux, Car il anéantira tous les dieux de la terre; Et chacun se prosternera devant lui dans son pays, Dans toutes les îles des nations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእነርሱ ላይ የተፈራ ይሆናል፥ የምድርንም አማልክት ሁሉ ያከሳቸዋል፤ በአሕዛብም ደሴቶች ሁሉ ላይ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ በስፍራቸው ሆነው ለእርሱ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
verses.fr: Vous aussi, Ethiopiens, Vous serez frappés par mon épée.
verses.am: እናንተም ኢትዮጵያውያን ደግሞ፥ በሰይፌ ትገደላላችሁ።

verses.en: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
verses.fr: Il étendra sa main sur le septentrion, Il détruira l''Assyrie, Et il fera de Ninive une solitude, Une terre aride comme le désert.
verses.am: እርሱም በሰሜን ላይ እጁን ይዘረጋል፥ አሦርንም ያጠፋል፤ ነነዌንም ባድማ፥ እንደ በረሃም ደረቅ ያደርጋታል።

verses.en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds; for he shall uncover the cedar work.
verses.fr: Des troupeaux se coucheront au milieu d''elle, Des animaux de toute espèce; Le pélican et le hérisson Habiteront parmi les chapiteaux de ses colonnes; Des cris retentiront aux fenêtres; La dévastation sera sur le seuil, Car les lambris de cèdre seront arrachés.
verses.am: መንጎችም የምድርም አራዊት ሁሉ በውስጥዋ ይመሰጋሉ፤ ይብራና ጃርት በዓምዶችዋ መካከል ያድራሉ፤ ድምፃቸው በመስኮቶችዋ ይጮኻል፤ የዝግባም እንጨት ሥራ ይገለጣልና በመድረኮችዋ ላይ ጥፋት ይሆናል።

verses.en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.fr: Voilà donc cette ville joyeuse, Qui s''assied avec assurance, Et qui dit en son coeur: Moi, et rien que moi! Eh quoi! elle est en ruines, C''est un repaire pour les bêtes! Tous ceux qui passeront près d''elle Siffleront et agiteront la main.
verses.am: ተዘልላ የተቀመጠች፥ በልብዋም። እኔ ነኝ፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም ያለች ደስተኛይቱ ከተማ ይህች ናት፤ አራዊት የሚመሰጉባት ባድማ እንዴት ሆነች! በእርስዋ በኩል የሚያልፈው ሁሉ እጁን እያወዛወዘ ያፍዋጫል።

verses.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
verses.fr: Malheur à la ville rebelle et souillée, A la ville pleine d''oppresseurs!
verses.am: ለዓመፀኛይቱና ለረከሰች ለአስጨናቂይቱም ከተማ ወዮላት!

verses.en: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.
verses.fr: Elle n''écoute aucune voix, Elle n''a point égard à la correction, Elle ne se confie pas en l''Eternel, Elle ne s''approche pas de son Dieu.
verses.am: ድምፅን አልሰማችም፥ ተግሣጽንም አልተቀበለችም፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አልታመነችም፥ ወደ አምላክዋም አልቀረበችም።

verses.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
verses.fr: Ses chefs au milieu d''elle sont des lions rugissants; Ses juges sont des loups du soir qui ne gardent rien pour le matin.
verses.am: በውስጥዋ ያሉ አለቆችዋ እንደሚያገሡ አንበሶች ናቸው፤ ፈራጆችዋም እስከ ነገ ድረስ ምንም እንደማያስቀሩ እንደ ማታ ተኵላዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
verses.fr: Ses prophètes sont téméraires, infidèles; Ses sacrificateurs profanent les choses saintes, violent la loi.
verses.am: ነቢያቶችዋ ቅሌታሞችና ተንኰለኞች ሰዎች ናቸው፤ ካህናቶችዋም መቅደሱን አርክሰዋል፥ በሕግም ላይ ግፍ ሠርተዋል።

verses.en: The just Lord is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est juste au milieu d''elle, Il ne commet point d''iniquité; Chaque matin il produit à la lumière ses jugements, Sans jamais y manquer; Mais celui qui est inique ne connaît pas la honte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በውስጥዋ ጻድቅ ነው፤ ክፋትን አያደርግም፤ ፍርዱን በየማለዳው ወደ ብርሃን ያወጣል፥ ሳያወጣውም አይቀርም፤ ዓመፀኛው ግን እፍረትን አያውቅም።

verses.en: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
verses.fr: J''ai exterminé des nations; leurs tours sont détruites; J''ai dévasté leurs rues, plus de passants! Leurs villes sont ravagées, plus d''hommes, plus d''habitants!
verses.am: አሕዛብን አጥፍቻለሁ፤ ግንቦቻቸው ሁሉ ፈርሰዋል፤ መንገዳቸውን ማንም እንዳያልፍባት ምድረ በዳ አድርጌአለሁ፥ ከተሞቻቸውም ማንም እንዳይኖርባቸው፥ አንድስ እንኳ እንዳይቀመጥባቸው ፈርሰዋል።

verses.en: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
verses.fr: Je disais: Si du moins tu voulais me craindre, Avoir égard à la correction, Ta demeure ne serait pas détruite, Tous les châtiments dont je t''ai menacée n''arriveraient pas; Mais ils se sont hâtés de pervertir toutes leurs actions.
verses.am: እኔም- ይፈሩኛል፥ ተግሣጽንም ይቀበላሉ፤ ካዘዝኋትም ሁሉ ከዓይንዋ ምንም አይጠፋም ብዬ ነበር፤ እነርሱ ግን በማለዳ ተነሥተው ድርጊታቸውን ሁሉ አረከሱ።

verses.en: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.fr: Attendez-moi donc, dit l''Eternel, Au jour où je me lèverai pour le butin, Car j''ai résolu de rassembler les nations, De rassembler les royaumes, Pour répandre sur eux ma fureur, Toute l''ardeur de ma colère; Car par le feu de ma jalousie tout le pays sera consumé.
verses.am: መዓቴንና የቍጣዬን ትኵሳት ሁሉ አፈስስባቸው ዘንድ ፍርዴ አሕዛብን ለመሰብሰብ፥ መንግሥታትንም ለማከማቸት ነውና፥ ምድርም ሁሉ በቅንዓቴ እሳት ትበላለችና ስለዚህ ለመበዝበዝ እስከምነሣበት ቀን ድረስ ጠብቁኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.
verses.fr: Alors je donnerai aux peuples des lèvres pures, Afin qu''ils invoquent tous le nom de l''Eternel, Pour le servir d''un commun accord.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም አሕዛብ ሁሉ አንድ ሆነው እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ስሙን እንዲጠሩ ንጹሐን ልሳን እመልስላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
verses.fr: D''au delà des fleuves de l''Ethiopie Mes adorateurs, mes dispersés, m''apporteront des offrandes.
verses.am: ከኢትዮጵያ ወንዞች ማዶ የሚማልዱኝ፥ የተበተኑት ሴቶች ልጆቼ፥ ቍርባኔን ያመጡልኛል።

verses.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, tu n''auras plus à rougir de toutes tes actions Par lesquelles tu as péché contre moi; Car alors j''ôterai du milieu de toi ceux qui triomphaient avec arrogance, Et tu ne t''enorgueilliras plus sur ma montagne sainte.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እየታበዩ የሚፎክሩትን ከመካከልሽ አወጣለሁና፥ አንቺም በቅዱስ ተራራዬ ዳግመኛ አትኰሪምና በዚያ ቀን በእኔ ላይ ተላልፈሽ በሠራሽው ሥራ ሁሉ አትፍሪም።

verses.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Je laisserai au milieu de toi un peuple humble et petit, Qui trouvera son refuge dans le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በመካከልሽም የዋህና ትሑት ሕዝብን አስቀራለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.fr: Les restes d''Israël ne commettront point d''iniquité, Ils ne diront point de mensonges, Et il ne se trouvera pas dans leur bouche une langue trompeuse; Mais ils paîtront, ils se reposeront, et personne ne les troublera.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቅሬታ ኃጢአትን አይሠሩም፥ ሐሰትንም አይናገሩም፥ በአፋቸውም ውስጥ ተንኰለኛ ምላስ አይገኝም፤ እነርሱም ይሰማራሉ፥ ይመሰጉማል፥ የሚያስፈራቸውም የለም።

verses.en: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Pousse des cris de joie, fille de Sion! Pousse des cris d''allégresse, Israël! Réjouis-toi et triomphe de tout ton coeur, fille de Jérusalem!
verses.am: የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ዘምሪ፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እልል በል፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ ሆይ፥ በፍጹም ልብሽ ሐሤት አድርጊ ደስም ይበልሽ።

verses.en: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a détourné tes châtiments, Il a éloigné ton ennemi; Le roi d''Israël, l''Eternel, est au milieu de toi; Tu n''as plus de malheur à éprouver.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፍርድሽን አስወግዶአል፥ ጠላትሽንም ጥሎአል፤ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እግዚአብሔር በመካከልሽ አለ፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ክፉ ነገርን አታዪም።

verses.en: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, on dira à Jérusalem: Ne crains rien! Sion, que tes mains ne s''affaiblissent pas!
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ለኢየሩሳሌም። ጽዮን ሆይ፥ አትፍሪ፥ እጆችሽም አይዛሉ።

verses.en: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, est au milieu de toi, comme un héros qui sauve; Il fera de toi sa plus grande joie; Il gardera le silence dans son amour; Il aura pour toi des transports d''allégresse.
verses.am: አምላክሽ እግዚአብሔር በመካከልሽ ታዳጊ ኃያል ነው፤ በደስታ በአንቺ ደስ ይለዋል፥ በፍቅሩም ያርፋል፥ በእልልታም በአንቺ ደስ ይለዋል ይባላል።

verses.en: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
verses.fr: Je rassemblerai ceux qui sont dans la tristesse, loin des fêtes solennelles, Ceux qui sont sortis de ton sein; L''opprobre pèse sur eux.
verses.am: ከጉባኤው ርቀው የሚያዝኑትን፥ ከአንቺም የሆኑትን እሰበስባለሁ፤ ስድብ እንደ ሸክም ከብዶባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
verses.fr: Voici, en ce temps-là, j''agirai contre tous tes oppresseurs; Je délivrerai les boiteux et je recueillerai ceux qui ont été chassés, Je ferai d''eux un sujet de louange et de gloire Dans tous les pays où ils sont en opprobre.
verses.am: በዚያ ዘመን እነሆ፥ ባስጨነቁሽ ሁሉ ላይ አደርግባቸዋለሁ፤ አንካሳይቱንም አድናለሁ፥ የተጣለችውንም እሰበስባታለሁ፤ ባፈሩባትም ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ለምስጋናና ለከበረ ስም አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, je vous ramènerai; En ce temps-là, je vous rassemblerai; Car je ferai de vous un sujet de gloire et de louange Parmi tous les peuples de la terre, Quand je ramènerai vos captifs sous vos yeux, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያ ዘመን አስገባችኋለሁ፥ በዚያም ዘመን እሰበስባችኋለሁ፤ ምርኮአችሁንም በዓይናችሁ ፊት በመለስሁ ጊዜ በምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ለከበረ ስምና ለምስጋና አደርጋችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
